import subprocess, pathlib

# Kill the rogue old vps_agent (PID 10868) that survived the restart
# Current valid agent PID is in the PID file
pid_f = pathlib.Path('C:/cits/vps_agent.pid')
current_pid = pid_f.read_text(encoding='utf-8').strip() if pid_f.exists() else ''
print('CURRENT_PID:', current_pid)

rogue_pid = '10868'
if rogue_pid != current_pid and rogue_pid:
    # Verify it's a pythonw.exe before killing
    chk = subprocess.run(
        ['tasklist', '/fi', f'PID eq {rogue_pid}', '/fi', 'IMAGENAME eq pythonw.exe', '/fo', 'csv', '/nh'],
        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
    if rogue_pid in chk.stdout:
        r = subprocess.run(['taskkill', '/f', '/pid', rogue_pid], capture_output=True, text=True)
        print('KILLED_ROGUE:', rogue_pid, r.returncode)
    else:
        print('ROGUE_NOT_FOUND (already gone):', rogue_pid)

# Show final state
out = subprocess.run(['tasklist', '/fi', 'IMAGENAME eq pythonw.exe', '/fo', 'csv', '/nh'],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=5)
print('PYTHONW_NOW:', out.stdout.strip())
print('PID_FILE:', current_pid)
